summary: @servicetitan/schema-comparison preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/` into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a shipped ~727 KB obfuscated JavaScript file `math_init.js`. The declared package purpose is a text schema-diff CLI (main: `dist/app.js`); its TypeScript sources make no reference to `math_init.js` or Bun. `math_init.js` is a single-line Bun-compiled blob using rotated string-array decoding and hex-named identifiers, invoked only by the freshly-downloaded alternate runtime. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: `npm install` unconditionally fetches a second interpreter and hands it a large obfuscated script whose behavior is unrelated to the advertised library. The `@servicetitan` scope with an otherwise plausible schema-diff library serves as a cover story around the install-time execution surface.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
